finding.claim: judging.md defines covered first as '`recorded` is not empty', but a record-only change always has a non-empty recorded, so the two answers overlap and the text never says which one wins. The runs answered record-only for 4487cc8e, but a batch judge reading the rules in order can answer covered, and then the change drops out of the report's 'Records with no change of their own' list.

fixes.change: record-only is defined first and wins over covered; covered applies otherwise.
The judging-reference test checks that record-only wins and the reworded covered rule.
